Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks for the quick response and the questionnaire — we'll start populating that. Short answers to your questions and the technical details you requested: 

SOC 2
- Redwood Inference completed SOC 2 Type II (security) in Nov 2025. We provide a customer-access copy of the SOC 2 report under NDA; we also publish a redacted summary for prospects. Link: https://redwood.example.com/soc2-report/LUM-REDACTED

SAML / SSO
- We act as a Service Provider (SP). We support SAML 2.0 with Okta, AzureAD, and most enterprise IdPs.
- You'll find our SP metadata attached (saml-metadata.xml) which includes entityID and ACS endpoints. Typical config values:
  • SP Entity ID: https://account.redwood.com/saml/metadata
  • ACS URL: https://account.redwood.com/saml/acs
  • NameID: transient or email (we recommend email for provisioning)

SCIM / Provisioning
- We support SCIM v2 with bearer-token authentication. Endpoints and required scopes are in the attached scim-api-spec.md. Sample base: https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2
- Supported operations: GET /Users, POST /Users, PUT/PATCH /Users/{id}, DELETE /Users/{id}
- We support full provisioning (create/update/deactivate). JIT can be supported for JIT-initiated SSO flows but is limited to specific providers — we can discuss on the tech call.

RBAC & Admin controls
- Built-in roles: owner, admin, manager, viewer.
- Admin actions are logged with audit events (user, action, timestamp).
- We maintain an access matrix for accounts; attached id-access-matrix.xlsx is a template you can fill or we can pre-populate based on your input.

Attachments (stubs): saml-metadata.xml (XML), scim-api-spec.md (MD), id-access-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

Next steps
- Dev, can you pick 2-3 windows for a 30-min technical configuration call with Lumina's IdP team?
- Tom/Priya: if you can send the Okta metadata (or confirm you want us to generate SP metadata in a specific format), we'll prep and send a test account.
